Slots: shooter<g> (motor on joint spin<g: Slots: shooter<g> (motor on joint spin<g>, one per wheel group: shooter0, shooter1, ...), and tilt (motor) and tilt_encoder (channel turns) with an articulated tilt. The channel body's origin is the disc's centre at the entry: x downrange, y left, z normal to the channel (the disc's axis); it is the base's frame pitched up by the launch angle about y. The tilt joint reads 0 at the low stop: launch angle = tilt_range[0] + the joint's angle. In the world the {shooter_table} section's disc launcher model runs the wheel shafts and the spin joints mirror them.
